title: Apologetical
summary: APOLOGET'ICAL, a. [Gr. to speak in defense of; and speech.] Defending by words or arguments; excusing; said or written in defense, or by way of apology; as an apologetic essay.

inlines.v: APOLOGET'ICAL, a. [Gr. to speak in defense of; and speech.] Defending by words or arguments; excusing; said or written in defense, or by way of apology; as an apologetic essay.
